notes.title: Shadowed Descent - Release
notes.notes:
A series of inexplicable events spread throughout the village, causing chaos and disrupting the balance, leading you to find clues using all available resources to unravel the mysteries that triggered this chaos and disorder.

Enjoy 20% discount on first 7 days!

Wishlist the game and add it to your library and find the mistery behind the village in 27/06/2024. Blackhaven waits for you!
